question: For each instance display name and migration status, considering only completed migrations for instances whose display name matches the regular expression 'prime' and where the maximum total memory (MEMORY_TOTAL) is greater than 0, list only those instance/status/created-at groups whose maximum total memory is greater than the average of these maximum total memory values across all such groups, and show the display name, status, max total memory, and migration created timestamp. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT 
    i.display_name,
    m.status,
    m.created_at,
    MAX(m.memory_total) AS max_memory_total
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  WHERE m.status = 'completed'
    AND i.display_name REGEXP 'prime'
  GROUP BY i.display_name, m.status, m.created_at
  HAVING MAX(m.memory_total) > 0
),
avg_stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(max_memory_total) AS avg_max_memory
  FROM base
)
SELECT 
  b.display_name,
  b.status,
  b.max_memory_total,
  b.created_at
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN avg_stats a
WHERE b.max_memory_total > a.avg_max_memory
